tour.title: Runtime Purpose & Topology
tour.description: Start with project knowledge that explains how gddp-runtime executes graph truth without owning it, and how deploy topology fits the Mini host model.

tour.title: Heartbeat Engine
tour.description: The continuous control loop: claim work, classify, dispatch executors, reconcile sessions, and record state.

tour.title: Executor Adapters
tour.description: Neutral executor contract and concrete adapters that let heartbeat dispatch Jules or local subprocess sessions without hardcoding one runtime.

tour.title: Verification Pipeline
tour.description: After jobs return, deterministic probes and semantic evaluators produce typed verdicts, integrity results, and receipts that can fail a job without rewriting graph truth.

tour.title: Decision Loop Powers
tour.description: Operator powers over verified results: accept a node, dispatch next work, or escalate when evidence is incomplete.

tour.title: Return Path & Persistence
tour.description: How completed work is stored, routed back into graph updates, and replayed for audit.

tour.title: Jobs CLI & Intake Surface
tour.description: Operator entry points for jobs status, webhook intake, local agent execution, and canary tooling.

tour.title: Deploy & Mini-Heartbeat Ops
tour.description: Host-level arm/disarm/baseline scripts that keep the Mini heartbeat production path operable without owning graph truth.
